description: This Java class, ZilkerClientFactory, provides a factory method for creating instances of NativeZilkerClient. It determines whether the environment supports native Zilker client operations (specifically on Linux or Mac OS), and attempts to locate and instantiate the native client accordingly. If it fails to do so, it throws a RuntimeException.

classes.name: ZilkerClientFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of NativeZilkerClient, selecting native or fallback implementations based on the OS environment.

methods.name: getNativeZilkerClient
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of NativeZilkerClient if compatible native client is available, otherwise throws a RuntimeException.
